basic_details.job_title: Amrita Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham has invited applications for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) for the MoES funded project titled “Virtual Reality enabled Deep sea exploration and Resource Identification” with the application deadline of October 31, 2026. The selected candidate will work on developing a Panoramic view for a VR platform for real-time 360-degree underwater views at Kollam, Kerala.

Review the detailed qualification and mandatory CSIR-UGC NET or GATE requirements.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is conducting recruitment for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under a Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES) funded project. The selected research fellow will be stationed at Kollam, Kerala, under the WNA department. The appointment centers on developing a panoramic view for a virtual reality platform designed for real-time 360-degree underwater views during deep sea exploration and resource identification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position must meet the mandatory educational qualification and examination requirements specified by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham. Educational Qualification: M.Tech/BTech in Computer Science, Electronics or related disciplines or MCA. Mandatory Examination: Candidate should have cleared CSIR-UGC NET/ GATE examination. content_sections.heading: Amrita Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will work on developing a Panoramic view for a VR platform for real-time 360-degree underwater views as part of the MoES funded project titled “Virtual Reality enabled Deep sea exploration and Resource Identification”.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Access the official recruitment page on the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham website. Navigate to the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) @AWNA job notification. Review the detailed qualification and mandatory CSIR-UGC NET or GATE requirements. Click on the apply option provided on the page to submit your application online. Ensure the application is submitted on or before the last date of October 31, 2026.
